name: blockascene
description: Block4Film offline-first scene blocking studio for Windows, macOS, Android and iOS
author: strijbos.media

scripts.dist:win: npm run icons && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.test:model: node tests/model.test.cjs && node tests/playback.test.cjs && node tests/manual.test.cjs && node tests/ui-v11.test.cjs && node tests/ui-v111.test.cjs && node tests/ui-v112.test.cjs && node tests/redesign-v2.test.cjs && node tests/ui-v121.test.cjs && node tests/portability-v13.test.cjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run icons && node scripts/build-mac-icon.cjs && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios
